name: exam
description: Golden set for /api/exam — 期中 / 期末模擬考. For each examType the runner calls action=generate, checks the exam shape (15 regular questions, sequential ids, 4 options per MC, sourceChapter within chapterRange, points sum within pointsRange), then calls action=grade with a canned answer set (MC → "A", short answers → cannedShortAnswer, interactive optics → sliders at initial values via opticsResults) and checks the grade result (one entry per question, totals consistent, grade letter, Traditional-Chinese feedback).

cannedShortAnswer.midterm: 先畫受力圖並選定座標軸，對每個物體列出牛頓第二定律 $\sum \vec{F} = m\vec{a}$；若系統只受保守力作功，則改用機械能守恆 $K_1 + U_1 = K_2 + U_2$ 解題，最後檢查單位與極限情況是否合理。
cannedShortAnswer.final: 先判斷系統的對稱性並選擇適當的高斯面或安培迴路，寫出對應的 Maxwell 方程式（例如 $\oint \vec{E}\cdot d\vec{A} = Q_{enc}/\varepsilon_0$），代入邊界條件後化簡；若是熱力學題則由第一定律 $\Delta U = Q - W$ 出發，再檢查正負號與單位。
cannedShortAnswer.default: 先寫出相關的物理定律與假設，代入題目條件後化簡，最後檢查單位與極限情況是否合理。
